task_objective: Implement the ui-legibility plan for readable SQL line numbers, named schema headers, and labelled query controls.
tests_added: MainWindow line-margin geometry test at 5, 50, and 500 lines plus a 24pt font change.
MainWindow schema test that switches from customers to loans.
Loop-driven MainWindow control-label and tooltip test for all six named controls.
design_decisions: Margin zero uses QFontMetrics over the widest digit string plus one digit of padding, and refreshes after every font-size change.
Schema-result handling resolves the updated CatalogEntry before rendering so the panel has the active alias.
Query configuration moved to a dedicated second toolbar row with a horizontal scroll area, keeping every labelled setting reachable at narrow widths.

verification.typecheck: ./run.sh uv run ty check . passed after syncing the declared spark extra into /tmp/wherewolf/.venv
toolbar_controls: engine_selector: Execution engine — Choose where the query runs: DuckDB or Spark.

preview_limit_selector: Preview rows — Choose the maximum number of rows shown in a query preview.
editor_theme_selector: Editor theme — Choose the colour theme used by the SQL editor.
translation_target_selector: Translation target — Choose the SQL dialect rendered in the Translation tab.
